title: Store followed by a bounded computation
statement: Let a program, depth bound, list $l$ of integers, memory map $\mu:\mathbb N\to\mathbb Z$, time bound $T\in\mathbb N$, postcondition $Q$, expressions $a,e$, statement $s$, address $b\in\mathbb N$, and value $z\in\mathbb Z$ be given. Suppose that $s$ can execute from the state with locations given by the frame of $l$ and memory updated at $b$ to $z$, within time $T-(\operatorname{cost}(a)+\operatorname{cost}(e)+1)$, and end in a state satisfying $Q$. Suppose also that $a,e$ are safe in the original state and evaluate respectively to $b,z$, and that $b$ is less than the space bound. Then storing $e$ at address $a$ and executing $s$ from the original state ends in a state satisfying $Q$ within time $T$, provided the store cost is at most $T$.
hypotheses_covered: The following statement $s$ has a $Q$-satisfying execution within the remaining time from locations given by the frame and memory updated at $b$ to $z$
The address expression is safe and evaluates to $b$ in the original state
The value expression is safe and evaluates to $z$ in the original state
$b$ is less than the space bound
The store cost is at most $T$
